name: Hiwa Touko
source:
Touko is the bright and cheerful classmate of the protagonist, although she can be innocent at times. She has a personality similar to a cat and loves being close to and being petted by the protagonist whom she feels safe with. Touko is also a member of the broadcasting club and she is the host of the radio program “QQQ”. She’s also very popular amongst the other students.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/20/previewstrawberry-nauts/]Liemyx's preview[/url]]
